name: @futureox/design-desktop
description: Local-first Futureox Design desktop editor with a Rust local backend

scripts.dev: bun run install:runtime && bun run build --fast && bun run start
scripts.build:host: node --check src/main.mjs && node --check src/preload.cjs && node --check src/security.mjs && node --check src/sidecar.mjs && node --check src/ffmpeg-encode.mjs && node --check scripts/ffmpeg-bundle.mjs && node --check src/workspace-sqlite-worker.mjs && node --check src/workspace-sqlite-worker-host.mjs && node --check src/product-export.mjs
scripts.package:native: bun run build && node scripts/package.mjs && bun run verify:package
scripts.package:exact: bun run build && node scripts/package.mjs --exact && node scripts/verify-package.mjs --exact
scripts.package:preview: bun run build && node scripts/package.mjs --preview && node scripts/verify-package.mjs --preview
scripts.package:local: node scripts/build.mjs --release && node scripts/package.mjs --local && node scripts/verify-package.mjs --local
